drafts.name: draft-1
drafts.prompt:
Create a NEW 2D BODY RECONSTRUCTION / TURNAROUND PROPOSAL review sheet from the five supplied official Emilia anime images. This is a proposed animation model-sheet reconstruction, NOT an official sheet, NOT a 3D render, and NOT a schematic graph. Only Emilia's adult stylized upper torso, covered by a plain light-gray fitted bodysuit for technical presentation. No nudity, nipples, erotic framing, hair, head, cape, ornaments or white chest garment on the reconstructed drawings.

Input roles, in supplied order:
1 S4 near-front neutral frame: primary front evidence; white panels conceal most anterior body.
2 S4 seated near-side: primary side support, with sitting pose, camera and garment caveats.
3 S4 standing side/oblique: primary continuity support, with arm and camera caveats.
4 S4 leaning 3/4: primary oblique support, not a neutral blueprint.
5 official S1 neutral turnaround: SECONDARY front/side structural support only. Never copy its cup edge, corset, costume outline or older costume proportion onto the S4 body.
Do not use any previous generated model, test image, magenta V3 graph or numerical body measurements.

Draw a large readable landscape sheet, preferably 3840 x 2160, on warm white paper with restrained clean animation design ink, light neutral body shading and fine construction flow lines. Upper row: three large COMPLETE visually interpretable torso drawings, neck base to waist, short relaxed upper-arm context, identical neutral posture and vertical scale, labeled FRONT, TRUE SIDE, 3/4. True front must be straight-on; true side must be 90 degrees facing left; 3/4 must turn 40 degrees to the left. Show the same continuous neutral volume in all three, not three separately designed silhouettes. Keep surrounding shoulders/neck/waist as context only. Use subtle shading to explain continuous surface rotation, not dramatic cast shadows or a dark hollow.

The anterior form is part of the ribcage surface. Give it a gentle upper transition, bounded fuller arc and extended smooth lower transition. Front outer contours widen gradually then narrow into the ribcage, without a rectangular chest region. The surface turns continuously through the medial and outer regions. Preserve shallow natural bilateral character while avoiding drawn cup outlines or a separate central mass. No horizontal lower chest edge, horizontal shadow band, shelf, bowl-shaped front, central dent, lower paired pockets, planar frontal slab, attached circles, separate anterior lobes or inflated outer shoulders. The TRUE SIDE silhouette must be a complete readable continuously changing curve from upper ribcage through a broadly rounded fullest arc and a long lower return into ribcage/abdomen, with no straight sloping face, wedge, triangular tip, point-like crest, circular hemisphere, abrupt inward return or distinct boundary where a front mass ends. The 3/4 drawing is especially important: make front-to-side flow readable as one ribcage wrap, with a smooth armpit junction and no pinching. Do not turn the side view into three dots or a polyline.

Second row: FIVE labeled horizontal cross-sections A UPPER ONSET, B RISING FULLNESS, C FULLEST ARC, D LOWER RETURN, E LOWER RIBCAGE. One smoothly closed torso perimeter per level, always FRONT at bottom and BACK at top, at a shared drawing scale. Each perimeter describes the whole body section including rear and sides. No detached circles or ellipsoids. No front central notch, paired lobes or lower pockets. Sections change progressively in width, anterior depth and lateral wrap; posterior region stays restrained. Keep the widths consistent with the front drawing and depths consistent with the side drawing. Show matching A-E level leaders OUTSIDE the three torso drawings, rather than horizontal bands drawn across the body. Add light surface-flow curves where useful, never seam or crease lines.

Third row: corresponding supplied S4 front, seated side, standing oblique reference crops with thin proposal outline overlays. Retain recognizable supplied original art as reference evidence, never fabricate an uncovered torso and call it official. Proposal outlines are pose-adjusted hypotheses only. Mark concealed proposed contours with ORANGE DASHED lines and the word INTERPOLATED. Mark only directly visible skin/bodysuit contour evidence with TEAL short solid strokes. Identify actual white garment boundaries separately in BLUE. Add a small S1 front/side inset labeled SECONDARY STRUCTURE ONLY. Do not treat an outer garment boundary as an underlying body observation. Gray camera/pose marks may explain lean. Drawings and all cross-sections are PROPOSED INTERPOLATION where clothing hides anatomy.

Exact sheet text: "EMILIA | BODY RECONSTRUCTION PROPOSAL", "DRAWING REVIEW ONLY", "S4 PRIMARY / S1 SECONDARY", "INTERPOLATED", "A BODY / B GARMENT / P POSE / C HIDDEN", "NO MESH EDIT / NO GLB BUILD". Keep text short and legible. Do not claim measurements, approval or proven anatomical accuracy. The result should let a reviewer assess the entire intended volume before a single vertex moves.
drafts.reason: Rejected drawing: paired under-chest folds, repeated sections and altered reference inserts.

Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve a readable same-scale FRONT, TRUE SIDE facing left, and 40-degree left 3/4 trio, neck base through waist. Crop away hips and lower body. Plain gray fitted bodysuit for neutral nonsexual technical display of an adult anime torso. IMPORTANT CORRECTIONS:
Remove every drawn UNDER-CHEST FOLD, under-chest crease, curved bra-cup edge, curved dark band under each side, center vertical depression and central cleavage construction. The first draft's paired dark curves wrongly portray two padded rounded objects. The front must read as a softly full continuous stylized thoracic surface. Use a broad, gentle gray tonal transition with no separate lower breast boundary and no cavity-like dark center. Retain human bilateral character very subtly, without outlines of two individual cup forms. Narrow smoothly toward lower ribs. Do not replace two cups with a single circular central dome or a flat rectangle. Show continuous smooth surface rotation around the lateral ribcage, with no armpit pinch.

TRUE SIDE: replace the first draft's nearly straight upper face and concentrated forward bend. Draw one uninterrupted silhouette with continuously changing tangent, a broad smooth maximum-projection arc, and a return extending gradually through levels D and E. REMOVE the fake 3D bulb/vase objects below the old cross-sections. Replace ALL of the repeated circle/oval sections with five genuinely different whole-torso contours at a common scale. Each is one closed smoothly asymmetrical front/back body section, symmetric left/right, FRONT at bottom BACK at top. A shallow anterior arc at A, smoothly increasing depth through B, greatest anterior depth at C, depth reducing smoothly at D, a compact lower-rib section at E. Rear curve restrained, lateral turn smoothly distributed. Wider part is anterior-lateral and medial front stays gently convex. No geometrically perfect repeated circles/ellipses, no paired lobes, medial notch, attached ellipsoids or extra independent objects. Widths and depths must match the trio, not be five unrelated symbols. Letters A-E and section leaders must be consistent. Place leaders OUTSIDE the torso; do not paint horizontal stripes across it. REMOVE ALL official-looking thumbnail redraws and reference overlay panels from this image. They altered the source costume and cannot count as evidence. The original unaltered references will be placed in a separate comparison document. Do not draw any substitute reference image. Large landscape production sketch on white. Clean anime construction drawing with restrained soft neutral shading, fine light cyan surface flow, no heavy anatomical grooves. Anterior hidden region uncertainty must be explicit in orange dashed OUTER construction contours beside the smooth artwork. Include short note "S4 primary. S1 secondary. Hidden chest is interpolation." and "NO MESH EDIT / NO GLB BUILD". This is an unapproved drawing for review.

drafts.name: draft-3
drafts.prompt:
Correct the unapproved DRAWING in image 1. Images 2-5 are official reference evidence only: S4 neutral front, S4 seated side, S4 standing oblique, S1 neutral turnaround SECONDARY ONLY. Do not copy their white garments or S1 cups into anatomy. This is an adult anime character upper-torso drawing review, NO 3D render or mesh.

Main correction is COMPLETE SURFACE CONTINUITY. Keep a FRONT, TRUE SIDE facing left, and left 40-degree 3/4 trio at one vertical scale, but remove the current draft's bulbous lower chest edges, lingering paired under-chest shadows and abrupt under-bust bend. Redraw the whole torso as a clean continuous animation construction form, covered by a plain seamless light-gray technical bodysuit. No tank straps, bra, corset, high-cut hip exposure, fabric folds or separate garment boundaries. Crop at the waist. Preserve restrained neutral anime shoulders, arm context and neck. No head or hair.

Use only light broad tone and fine pale blue curved surface-flow strokes. DO NOT DRAW any curved under-breast outline or dark shadow below either side, any central sternum groove, center dimple, medial notch, cup shape, shelf or lower pair of pockets. Shape must remain visually dimensional through contour and surface rotation, not flat or rectangular. A modest gradual upper-chest fullness is part of the ribcage. The fullest region is bounded and soft, without two attached balls or one central sphere. Front sides widen gradually below the armpit and return smoothly toward the ribs.

The TRUE SIDE needs a smaller, less concentrated bulge than the current drawing and a visibly LONG lower return. The upper curve progressively departs from the ribcage without a straight sloping face. Its maximum is a broad rounded arc, not a point. After the maximum, keep changing direction gently through lower chest and ribs, with NO identifiable sudden under-bust corner and no inward notch followed by an upright reset. Do not trace a hemispherical breast. Read the whole contour as continuous upper thorax, fullness, lower ribs. Preserve neutral pose and a restrained abdomen.
The 3/4 is the consistency view, show the same cross-section turning around the ribcage, neither two circular masses nor a planar front with sharp side turn.

SECTION LEVEL CORRECTION: A upper onset near upper thorax, B rising fullness, C fullest upper-torso region, D lower return shortly below C, E lower RIBCAGE above the waist. In the previous image E sat at the hip; fix this. Add a small unlabeled waist context below E. All three drawings use corresponding A-E heights.

RIGHT COLUMN has FIVE 2D horizontal sections, one whole closed torso outline at each level, same scale, posterior BACK on TOP, anterior FRONT on BOTTOM. These are not rib rings or ellipsoidal primitives. CRITICAL: do not give the BACK a large triangular/pointed dome while flattening the FRONT as the previous draft did. Posterior line must be a restrained shallow rounded arc. Smooth lateral arcs join a gently convex anterior arc. The anterior depth increases gradually from A to B, is greatest at C, then reduces at D and E. The whole front arc changes, not a circle appended to the existing torso. No central notch, twin lobes or separate internal circles. Width follows the main front drawing. Depth follows the main true side. No 3D bulb or vase sketches. Cross-sections are labeled PROPOSED / INTERPOLATED, not measured evidence.

Only the turnaround trio and five sections belong in this image. No fabricated/redrawn official reference inserts. Source images will be supplied separately unchanged. Use a white background with clear restrained animation design ink and soft gray tone. Orange dashed outer construction marks indicate hidden/interpolated shape without mimicking any garment edge. Short exact headings: "EMILIA | BODY RECONSTRUCTION", "DRAWING REVIEW ONLY", "FRONT", "TRUE SIDE", "3/4", "INTERPOLATED", "A UPPER ONSET", "B RISING FULLNESS", "C FULLEST REGION", "D LOWER RETURN", "E LOWER RIBCAGE", "BACK", "FRONT", "S4 PRIMARY / S1 SECONDARY", "NO MESH EDIT / NO GLB BUILD". Enough space to inspect entire side curve and all sections. Avoid under-chest band and large rear bulges in the sections.
drafts.reason: Rejected drawing: remaining folds and section orientation do not define a trustworthy target.
